title: Adding epic order to user-story listings took the ?epic= query parameter and str.format()-ed it into a raw SQL subquery passed to queryset.extra(), enabling time-based blind SQL injection.

vulnerable_findings.explanation: The function attach_epic_order builds a raw SQL query using the epic_id parameter taken directly from the request query string (via attach_extra_info) without verifying that the caller has permission to view that epic. This constitutes an IDOR risk where a user can supply any epic_id and retrieve ordering information for epics they do not own.
